title: Appending closed-fibre regular coordinates preserves flatness
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $\Lambda$ a Noetherian $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $q$ a prime ideal. Fix $t,e\geq0$, $x:\operatorname{Fin}(t)\to\Lambda$ and $z:\operatorname{Fin}(e)\to q$. Put $P_0=k[X_j]$, $\varphi_0(X_j)=x_j$, $p_0=\varphi_0^{-1}(q)$, $L=\Lambda_q$, and $I=p_0L$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Suppose $\varphi_0$ induces a flat local map $(P_0)_{p_0}\to L$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and the images of $z_i/1$ form a regular sequence in $L/I$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Put $P_1=k[X_j,Y_i]$ and $\varphi_1(X_j)=x_j$, $\varphi_1(Y_i)=z_i$, $p_1=\varphi_1^{-1}(q)$. Then the canonical local map $(P_1)_{p_1}\to L$ is flat.

proof.text: Evaluation on the first variables agrees with the original map, by extensionality on polynomial generators. Thus p₀ is the contraction of p₁ under variable renaming. Localization gives α:A₀→A₁, β:A₁→L and γ:A₀→L. The localization universal property proves β∘α=γ. The maps α and β are local.

Finite polynomial rings over a field and their prime localizations, as well as L, are Noetherian local rings. Equip the rings with the algebra structures from α, β and γ and the scalar tower from their composition.
The prescribed regular sequence gives flatness of (A₁/m₀A₁)⊗[A₁]L over A₁/m₀A₁ by the polynomial-append tensor-fibre lemma.

Apply the Noetherian fibre criterion with R=A₀, S=A₁, S′=L and M=L. The module is finite over itself and nonzero because L is local. Its A₀-flatness is hflat. The second conclusion is L flat over A₁, exactly flatness of the canonical localization map β.

theorem flat_polynomial_append_of_fibre_regular_sequence
    (k : Type u) (Λ : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (q : Ideal Λ) [q.IsPrime]
    (t e : ℕ) (xs : Fin t → Λ) (zs : Fin e → Λ)
    (hzq : ∀ i, zs i ∈ q)
    (hflat : (Localization.localRingHom
      (q.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom) q
      (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom rfl).Flat)
    (hseq : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
      (q.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q)).comp
          (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom))
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin e ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk
        ((q.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom).map
          ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q)).comp
            (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom))
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q) (zs i))))) :
    let φ : MvPolynomial (Fin (t + e)) k →ₐ[k] Λ :=
      MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.addCases xs zs)
    (Localization.localRingHom (q.comap φ.toRingHom) q φ.toRingHom rfl).Flat
